notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling and Multani's Harmony attached to Morselhoarder.
Morselhoarder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it to add a mana of any color.
Activate Sinking Feeling, by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Morselhoarder to untap it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it to add a mana of any color.
Repeat.
